messages.subject: How to effectively iterate inla.posterior.sample?
parts:
Hi all,

I generated 1000 samples through inla.posterior.sample, and calculated the mean of the 1000 samples. Then I’d like to repeat the process 1000 times. I hope to get 1000 means finally.

However, it will take much computation cost. Although I used a multicore cluster, the memory was still a problem.

I am wondering if there are any functions nested in inla package, which allow me to achieve the goal?

Thanks,
Rujia

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How to effectively iterate inla.posterior.sample?
parts:
I guess you have a larger model then. are you using PARDISO?

In the newer test versions, there are a 'selection' argument, for which
you do not need all part of the sample, you can define the part of the
sample you want. this saves memory.
